arabic text: YEH KHAT MEIN SHAH NE LIKHA, HABIB AA JAO\nTUMHARA DOST HAI TANHA\nHABIB AA JAO.
english translation text: IMAM HUSAYN (A) WROTE IN A LETTER, O HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME\nYOUR FRIEND IS ALONE,\nO HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME

arabic text: SHAHEED KAISE HOWA WOH, BATAO GAYE AA KAR.\nTUM HAAL-E-MUSLIM-E-BEKAS, SUNAO GAYE AA KAR.\nRUQAIYA TAKTI HAI RASTA HABIB AA JAO.
english translation text:
HOW WAS HE MARTYRED,
PLEASE COME AND TELL ME
PLEASE COME AND INFORM ME ABOUT HAZRAT MUSLIM’S SITUATION
RUQAYYAH IS WAITING ANXIOUSLY FOR YOU
O HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME

arabic text: BATA RAHA THA OSSE KOI BHI NAHI HAI MERA.\nTU BOLIN SANI-E-ZAHRA HABIB AAYE GA.\nHAI OSS KO TUM PE BHAROSA, HABIB AA JAO.
english translation text:
SOMEONE WAS TELLING HER THAT I AM LEFT WITH NO HELPER
BIBI ZAYNAB (A) CRIED 'HABIB
WILL DEFINITELY COME'
SHE HAS COMPLETE FAITH IN YOU
O HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME

arabic text: WOH JAB YEH SUNTI HAI KOFAY SE, AA RAHE HAIN SHAQI.\nTU POCHTI HAI HAMARA BHI AAYE GA KOI.\nDUAEIN DE GI SAKINA HABIB AA JAO.
english translation text:
WHEN SHE HEARS THAT ENEMIES ARE COMING FROM KUFA
SHE ASKS IF ANY SUPPORTERS WILL ALSO COME TO HELP US?
SAKINA WILL PRAY FOR YOU
O HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME

arabic text: MUJHE HAI YAAD WOH LAMHA JO RAB KI MARZI SE.\nTUM HO KE ZINDA MERI BAAT SUNNE AAYE THE\nBULA RAHA HOON DOBARA, HABIB AA JAO.
english translation text:
I STILL REMEMBER THE TIME WHEN WITH THE PERMISSION OF THE LORD...
YOU CAME BACK TO LIFE WHEN I CALLED YOU
I AM CALLING U AGAIN
O HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME

arabic text: DAR-E-BATOOL(SA) DOBARA JALAYA JAYE GA.\nTUMHARE DOST PE KHANJAR CHALAYA JAYE GA.\nNAHI HAI WAQT ZYADA, HABIB AA JAO.
english translation text:
THE DOOR OF BATOOL WILL BE BURNT ONCE AGAIN
A DAGGER WILL SLIT THE THROAT OF YOUR FRIEND
THERE IS NOT MUCH TIME LEFT
O HABIB PLEASE COME TO ME
